SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
CONFIDENTIAL REPORT

Special Branch. Station. File No. Date November 19, 1941.

SUBJECT: Nicolai Vassilievitch SNOPOFF
alias Nicola Snopow TSVETKOVITCH.

With reference to the attached enquiry from the
United States Consulate-General concerning the bona
fides of Nicola Snopow Tsvetkovitch, the following
information has been obtained: -

This person is known as Nicolai Vassilievitch
SNOPOFF and is of Russian nationality. N. V. Snopoff
uses his mother's maiden name 'TSVETKOVITCH' as an
alias and is reported to have succeeded in obtaining
Yugoslavian papers under this name. His career in
Shanghai is an adventurous one, he has always been
living by his wits, and has, in fact, prospered in
this manner.

Some years ago Snopoff was employed with the
CANIDROME in charge of Russian personnel. In 1936 -
1937 he is known to have been in close touch with the
Japanese Consular Police and suspected of acting as
an informer for the French Consulate, various local
Intelligence Services and anybody who is willing to
pay for information. At that time Snopoff styled
himself a Private Investigator and was a close
collaborator of V. M. KEDROLIVANSKY, ex-member of the
Shanghai Municipal Police, later employed by the
Japanese Consular Police as an adviser on Russian
affairs. In 1940, Snopoff appears under the name
of N. Tsvetkovitch as Business Manager of the "CHINA
LAW JOURNAL" (Publication now suspended). This paper
was owned by "Captain" Andrey Andreyevitch KOGALTKOFF

上海公共租界工部局警务处
机密报告

特务科。分局。档案号。日期：1941年11月19日。

主题：尼古拉·瓦西里耶维奇·斯诺波夫（Nicolai Vassilievitch SNOPOFF）
化名尼古拉·斯诺波·茨维特科维奇（Nicola Snopow TSVETKOVITCH）。

关于随附的美国总领事馆就尼古拉·斯诺波·茨维特科维奇之真实身份提出的查询，现获得如下信息：

此人名为尼古拉·瓦西里耶维奇·斯诺波夫，系俄罗斯国籍。N. V. 斯诺波夫使用其母姓“茨维特科维奇”作为化名，据报已以此名成功取得南斯拉夫证件。他在上海的经历颇具冒险色彩，一直靠耍小聪明谋生，且事实上以此方式发了财。

数年前，斯诺波夫受雇于逸园跑狗场（CANIDROME），负责管理俄籍人员。据悉在1936至1937年间，他与日本领事馆警察关系密切，并被怀疑充当法国领事馆、当地各情报机构以及任何愿意付费获取信息者的线人。当时，斯诺波夫自称私人侦探，并与V. M. 凯德罗利万斯基（V. M. KEDROLIVANSKY）紧密合作；后者曾任上海公共租界工部局警务处职员，后受雇于日本领事馆警察，担任俄国事务顾问。1940年，斯诺波夫以N. 茨维特科维奇之名出现，担任《中国法律评论》（CHINA LAW JOURNAL，该刊物现已停刊）的业务经理。该报所有者为安德烈·安德烈耶维奇·科加尔托夫（Andrey Andreyevitch KOGALTKOFF）“上尉”

（批注：抄送美国领事E. F. Stanton先生。1941年11月19日。el）

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1941年11月19日 特务科）

who has a very indifferent reputation in local business
circles. This person came to the notice of the Police
in May 1939, when he was alleged to have attempted to
bribe an employee of the "North-China Daily News" in
order to obtain the name of the author of a letter to
the editor, the subject of which was "Activities of
the Gestapo".

In 1940 SNOPOFF - TSVETKOVITCH married a certain
Mrs. Dvorjetz (divorcee of D. Dvorjetz, ex-owner of
D.D's Night Club) and shortly afterwards left Shanghai
for Brazil via Kobe aboard the s.s. "Taiye Maru" on
September 3, 1940. In March or April 1941 Snopoff
was again seen in Shanghai, but shortly afterwards
left again for South America. (Shipping lists fail to
record these movements). Prior to his departure he is
known to have bought a large amount of Chinese Curious,
and to have been in possession of great sums of money.
(Rumours put the figure at £30.000).

A telephone call was put through to the Sino-
Swiss Trading Co., at 118 Route Winling (listed 74583
in the China Hong List) and the undersigned was told
that the business telephone of the firm is 19775.
19775 is the number of Messrs. BABOUD, MARY & CIE.,
17 Canton Road. An anonymous call was put through to
that firm and it was learned that Tsvetkovitch is at
present the representative of the SINO-SWISS TRADING
COMPANY in Montevideo, Uruguay.

W. 19/11

(Special Branch).

D. S.

主题： - 2 - 续。

此人在当地商界声誉甚差。此人于1939年5月引起警方注意，当时他被指控企图贿赂《字林西报》（North-China Daily News）的一名雇员，以获取一封致编辑信件作者的姓名，该信的主题是“盖世太保的活动”。

1940年，斯诺波夫-茨维特科维奇娶了一位名叫德沃热茨夫人（Mrs. Dvorjetz，D. 德沃热茨的前妻，D.D.夜总会前所有者）的女子，随后不久于1940年9月3日乘坐“太叶丸”号轮船经神户离开上海前往巴西。1941年3月或4月，有人在上海再次见到斯诺波夫，但不久后他再次离开前往南美。（航运名单未记录这些行踪）。据悉在离境前，他购买了大量中国古玩，并持有巨额资金。（传闻金额达30,000英镑）。

致电位于文林路118号（在《China Hong List》中列为74583号）的中瑞贸易公司（Sino-Swiss Trading Co.），接听者告知本署员该公司的业务电话为19775。19775是广东路17号巴布德、玛丽及公司（Messrs. BABOUD, MARY & CIE.）的电话号码。向该公司拨打匿名电话后获悉，茨维特科维奇目前是中瑞贸易公司在乌拉圭蒙得维的亚的代表。

W. 19/11

（特务科）。

D. S.
